words.enDefinition: a set of questions students must solve for homework

examples.en: The problem set is due Friday, and question four is taking me forever.
examples.zh: 「习题集」周五截止，第四题花了我好长时间。

examples.en: Did you finish the problem set for linear algebra yet?
examples.zh: 你线性代数的「习题集」做完了吗？

words.enDefinition: an exercise for drilling a skill before graded work

examples.en: She warmed up with a few practice problems before starting the graded set.
examples.zh: 开始做计分作业前，她先练了几道「练习题」找感觉。

examples.en: I redo the practice problems until each solution method feels automatic.
examples.zh: 我会反复刷「练习题」，直到每种解法都熟练为止。

words.enDefinition: a short written reaction to readings due every week

examples.en: Our weekly response is due every Thursday night before midnight.
examples.zh: 我们的「每周短评」每周四午夜前要交。

examples.en: Keep each weekly response to about three hundred words maximum.
examples.zh: 每篇「每周短评」控制在三百词以内。

words.enDefinition: the question or instructions your essay must answer

examples.en: Read the essay prompt twice before you start outlining anything.
examples.zh: 动笔列提纲前，先把「作文题目」读两遍。

examples.en: I misread the essay prompt and had to rewrite my whole draft.
examples.zh: 我看错了「作文题目」，只好把整篇初稿重写。

words.enDefinition: a question you must answer in paragraph form

examples.en: Each essay question needs at least three clearly developed supporting points.
examples.zh: 每道「论述题」至少要有三个展开充分的论点。

examples.en: I misread the second essay question and answered the wrong chapter.
examples.zh: 第二道「论述题」我看错了，答错了章节。

words.enDefinition: homework that asks you to write an essay or report

examples.en: The writing assignment asks for two pages on climate policy.
examples.zh: 这份「写作作业」要求就气候政策写两页。

examples.en: She finished the writing assignment a full week before it was due.
examples.zh: 她在截止前整整一周就写完了「写作作业」。

words.enDefinition: chapters or articles you must read before class

examples.en: Finish the reading assignment before Tuesday's seminar or you'll be lost.
examples.zh: 周二研讨课之前要完成「阅读任务」，不然你会跟不上。

examples.en: The reading assignment for this week is two very long chapters.
examples.zh: 本周的「阅读任务」是特别长的两章。

words.enDefinition: homework you complete outside class and submit later

examples.en: The take-home assignment is open for two weeks, so pace yourself.
examples.zh: 这份「课后作业」有两周完成时间，注意安排节奏。

examples.en: I lost points on the take-home assignment for skipping part two.
examples.zh: 「课后作业」我漏做了第二部分，被扣了分。

words.enDefinition: a short paper analyzing your own thoughts or experience

examples.en: The reflection paper asks how the internship shaped your goals.
examples.zh: 这篇「反思报告」要写实习如何影响了你的职业目标。

examples.en: She wrote her reflection paper in first person, as the instructions allowed.
examples.zh: 按要求，她的「反思报告」用第一人称写。

words.enDefinition: a structured write-up of a science experiment

examples.en: My lab report needs graphs, so I'm exporting the data tonight.
examples.zh: 我的「实验报告」需要图表，今晚得把数据导出来。

examples.en: The lab report is due one week after the experiment ends.
examples.zh: 「实验报告」在实验结束后一周内交。

words.enDefinition: a long research paper written across the whole term

examples.en: Her term paper compares two economic models over twelve pages.
examples.zh: 她的「学期论文」用十二页比较了两种经济模型。

examples.en: Start your term paper early because finding sources takes time.
examples.zh: 「学期论文」要早点动笔，查资料很花时间。

words.enDefinition: the major end-of-term paper that counts heavily

examples.en: The final paper counts for forty percent of our grade.
examples.zh: 「期末论文」占我们成绩的百分之四十。

examples.en: I've narrowed my final paper down to two possible topics.
examples.zh: 我把「期末论文」的选题缩小到了两个方向。

words.enDefinition: a detailed analysis of one real example or company

examples.en: Our case study analyzes how the startup lost its early customers.
examples.zh: 我们的「案例分析」研究那家初创公司怎么流失了早期用户。

examples.en: Each group writes a case study on a company of their choice.
examples.zh: 每个小组要自选一家公司写「案例分析」。

words.enDefinition: the posted page detailing one assignment's requirements

examples.en: The assignment sheet lists the format, sources, and due date.
examples.zh: 「作业说明单」上列有格式、资料来源和截止日期。

examples.en: Lost the assignment sheet? Download it again from the course page.
examples.zh: 「作业说明单」丢了？去课程页面再下载一份。

words.enDefinition: your first forum post that classmates then reply to

examples.en: Your initial post is due Wednesday and replies by Friday.
examples.zh: 「首帖」周三截止，回复同学的帖子周五截止。

examples.en: Read the assigned article carefully before drafting your initial post.
examples.zh: 写「首帖」之前要仔细读指定文章。

words.enDefinition: the directions explaining what an assignment expects

examples.en: Read the assignment instructions carefully before emailing the professor questions.
examples.zh: 给教授发邮件提问之前，先仔细读一遍「作业要求」。

examples.en: Half the class ignored the assignment instructions and lost easy points.
examples.zh: 一半同学没看「作业要求」，白白丢了分。

words.enDefinition: the number of words your paper contains or needs

examples.en: My word count is two hundred over, so I'm cutting examples.
examples.zh: 我的「字数」超了两百，正在删例证。

examples.en: The word count excludes the title, headings, and cover page.
examples.zh: 「字数」不含标题、小标题和封面页。

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of words allowed for a paper

examples.en: The word limit for this essay is one thousand five hundred.
examples.zh: 这篇作文的「字数上限」是一千五百词。

examples.en: Going ten percent over the word limit can cost you marks.
examples.zh: 超过「字数上限」百分之十可能会被扣分。

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of pages an assignment may run

examples.en: The page limit is strict; the professor stops reading at page ten.
examples.zh: 「页数限制」很严格，教授读到第十页就不看了。

examples.en: Charts don't count toward the page limit for this report.
examples.zh: 这份报告里，图表不计入「页数限制」。

words.enDefinition: a table showing how points are awarded for work

examples.en: Check the rubric before you submit; it shows where the points are.
examples.zh: 交作业前先看「评分量表」，分值分布都在上面。

examples.en: The rubric gives five points just for having clear organization.
examples.zh: 「评分量表」里光结构清晰一项就占五分。

words.enDefinition: the detailed rules graders use to award marks

examples.en: The marking scheme awards most of the marks to your analysis section.
examples.zh: 「评分细则」把大部分分数给了分析部分。

examples.en: The TA walked us through the marking scheme before the due date.
examples.zh: 助教在截止日期前给我们逐条讲了「评分细则」。

words.enDefinition: the standards a professor uses to judge your work

examples.en: The grading criteria emphasize a clear argument over perfect grammar.
examples.zh: 「评分标准」看重论证清晰，而不是语法完美。

examples.en: The grading criteria are posted along with the essay prompt.
examples.zh: 「评分标准」和作文题目一起发布了。

words.enDefinition: the course rules on handing work in late

examples.en: The late policy takes off five percent for every day late.
examples.zh: 「迟交政策」规定每晚一天扣百分之五。

examples.en: Check the syllabus for the late policy before you email the professor.
examples.zh: 给教授发邮件之前，先在课程大纲里查一下「迟交政策」。

words.enDefinition: points removed because work was handed in late

examples.en: I submitted two days late and ate a twenty-point late penalty.
examples.zh: 我迟交了两天，吃了二十分的「迟交扣分」。

examples.en: The late penalty caps at thirty percent, so submit anyway.
examples.zh: 「迟交扣分」上限是百分之三十，所以还是要交。

words.enDefinition: marks taken off for an error or broken rule

examples.en: Each formatting error in the file carries a small point deduction.
examples.zh: 文件里每个格式错误都会有少量「扣分」。

examples.en: There's an automatic two-point deduction for a missing cover page.
examples.zh: 少了封面页会自动「扣两分」。

words.enDefinition: optional work that adds points beyond the normal total

examples.en: This problem set includes an extra credit question worth five points.
examples.zh: 这份习题集里有一道值五分的「附加分」题。

examples.en: Extra credit lifted my grade from B minus to B.
examples.zh: 「附加分」让我的成绩从 B− 升到了 B。

words.enDefinition: some points awarded even when the final answer is wrong

examples.en: Even with the wrong answer, I earned partial credit for the setup.
examples.zh: 虽然答案错了，但列式正确，我拿到了「过程分」。

examples.en: Show every step; the graders give partial credit for correct methods.
examples.zh: 每一步都写出来，方法对就有「过程分」。

words.enDefinition: all the points available for an item

examples.en: Follow the required format exactly if you want full credit.
examples.zh: 想要拿「满分」，就要严格按要求的格式来。

examples.en: You only get full credit if every part of the question is answered.
examples.zh: 只有每小问都答到才能拿「满分」。

words.enDefinition: the official solutions used to check or grade work

examples.en: The TA posted the answer key after the problem set closed.
examples.zh: 习题集提交截止后，助教上传了「参考答案」。

examples.en: Check your work against the answer key before asking questions.
examples.zh: 提问之前，先对照「参考答案」检查一遍。

words.enDefinition: write out each step instead of only the final answer

examples.en: The instructions say to show your work on every single question.
examples.zh: 要求里说每道题都要「写出解题步骤」。

examples.en: If you show your work, you can still earn partial credit.
examples.zh: 只要「写出解题步骤」，即使答错也有分。

collocations: show your work for each problem

words.enDefinition: The period after a deadline in which submissions may still be accepted.

examples.en: The late submission window closes on Friday, so I will upload the revised worksheet tomorrow.
examples.zh: 「允许迟交的时段」周五结束，我明天会上传修改后的练习单。

examples.en: I checked the late submission window before asking whether the portal would still accept my file.
examples.zh: 我先查了「允许迟交的时段」，然后才问提交系统是否还能接收文件。

collocations: submit within the late submission window

words.enDefinition: a first imperfect version you will improve later

examples.en: Finish a rough draft tonight so tomorrow is only for editing.
examples.zh: 今晚先写完「初稿」，明天专心修改。

examples.en: My rough draft was messy, but it gave me something to fix.
examples.zh: 我的「初稿」很粗糙，但至少有东西可改。

words.enDefinition: the polished last version you submit

examples.en: The final draft is due Friday; the rough draft was due Monday.
examples.zh: 「定稿」周五交，初稿周一交。

examples.en: Read your final draft aloud to catch any awkward sentences.
examples.zh: 把「定稿」朗读一遍，找出别扭的句子。

words.enDefinition: comments classmates give on your draft before revision

examples.en: We exchange written peer feedback in class every other week.
examples.zh: 我们每隔一周在课上互换书面「同伴反馈」。

examples.en: The peer feedback pointed out that my argument needed examples.
examples.zh: 「同伴反馈」指出我的论证缺少例子。

words.enDefinition: write something again in order to improve it

examples.en: I had to rewrite the opening paragraph after the professor's comments.
examples.zh: 看了教授的批注，我只好「重写」开头段。

examples.en: Don't rewrite the whole essay; sometimes moving one paragraph fixes it.
examples.zh: 不必「重写」整篇作文，有时挪动一段就解决了。

words.enDefinition: quickly list ideas before you start writing

examples.en: Spend ten minutes brainstorming before you start outlining the essay.
examples.zh: 列作文提纲之前，先花十分钟「头脑风暴」。

examples.en: Our group brainstormed three possible angles for the project topic.
examples.zh: 我们小组就项目主题「头脑风暴」出了三个角度。

words.enDefinition: make final small improvements to a nearly finished draft

examples.en: Polish your conclusion last, once the argument is fully settled.
examples.zh: 论证完全定下来之后，最后再「润色」结论。

examples.en: She spent the entire last hour just polishing her wording.
examples.zh: 最后一小时她全都在「润色」用词。

words.enDefinition: the campus website where assignment files are uploaded

examples.en: The submission portal closes at midnight sharp, with no exceptions.
examples.zh: 「提交门户」午夜准点关闭，没有例外。

examples.en: The submission portal was down for maintenance the whole evening.
examples.zh: 「提交门户」整晚都在维护，没法访问。

words.enDefinition: a confirmation page or email proving your work arrived

examples.en: Save the submission receipt in case the portal glitches later.
examples.zh: 保存好「提交回执」，以防门户之后出问题。

examples.en: My submission receipt says 11:58, two minutes before the cutoff.
examples.zh: 我的「提交回执」显示 11:58，比截止时间早两分钟。

words.enDefinition: the record showing whether your file was received

examples.en: Keep refreshing the page until the submission status turns green.
examples.zh: 一直刷新页面，直到「提交状态」变成绿色。

examples.en: My submission status still says pending, and that really worries me.
examples.zh: 我的「提交状态」还是待处理，真让人担心。

words.enDefinition: upload the assignment again, usually to fix a problem

examples.en: I uploaded the wrong file and had to resubmit before midnight.
examples.zh: 我传错了文件，只好在午夜前「重新提交」。

examples.en: You can resubmit until the deadline; only the last file counts.
examples.zh: 截止前可以「重新提交」，以最后一次文件为准。

words.enDefinition: replace your earlier uploaded file with a newer version

examples.en: The portal lets you overwrite a submission until the deadline.
examples.zh: 截止之前可以在门户里「覆盖提交」。

examples.en: I accidentally overwrote the whole submission with an empty document.
examples.zh: 我不小心用空文档把整个提交「覆盖」了。

collocations: overwrite a submission before the deadline

words.enDefinition: work handed in after the deadline has passed

examples.en: Late submissions lose five percent per day under the policy.
examples.zh: 按政策，「迟交的作业」每天扣百分之五。

examples.en: One late submission won't sink your grade if the rest are strong.
examples.zh: 只要其他都按时交，一次「迟交」不会毁了成绩。

words.enDefinition: a failure message when a file will not upload

examples.en: An upload error popped up because my file exceeded the size limit.
examples.zh: 文件超过大小限制，弹出了「上传错误」。

examples.en: I sent the professor a photo of the upload error as proof.
examples.zh: 我把「上传错误」的截图发给教授作证明。

words.enDefinition: a computer or internet problem that disrupts your work

examples.en: A technical issue wiped my essay an hour before the deadline.
examples.zh: 截止前一小时出了「技术故障」，我的论文没了。

examples.en: Email the professor immediately if a technical issue blocks your submission.
examples.zh: 如果「技术故障」耽误了提交，要立刻给教授发邮件。

words.enDefinition: the required file type, such as PDF or Word

examples.en: The assignment only accepts PDF, so check your file format.
examples.zh: 这份作业只收 PDF，注意检查「文件格式」。

examples.en: My file format was wrong, and the portal rejected it.
examples.zh: 我的「文件格式」不对，门户直接拒收了。

words.enDefinition: the label of your file, often following a set pattern

examples.en: Use the file name pattern on the instructions: last name, then assignment.
examples.zh: 按要求给「文件名」：先写姓氏，再写作业名。

examples.en: A clear file name helps the TA find your essay fast.
examples.zh: 清晰的「文件名」能让助教快速找到你的作文。

words.enDefinition: the maximum file size the portal will accept

examples.en: Compress the video; the portal's file size limit is fifty megabytes.
examples.zh: 把视频压缩一下，门户的「文件大小限制」是 50 兆。

examples.en: My scan was too big for the file size limit.
examples.zh: 我的扫描件太大，超过了「文件大小限制」。

words.enDefinition: produce a PDF copy of your document for uploading

examples.en: Always export as PDF so your formatting cannot shift or break.
examples.zh: 一定要「导出为 PDF」，排版就不会乱掉。

examples.en: The instructions say to export as PDF, not as Word.
examples.zh: 要求「导出为 PDF」，不要用 Word。

words.enDefinition: a text file created in Microsoft Word

examples.en: Upload your essay as a Word document so she can leave comments.
examples.zh: 作文要传「Word 文档」，方便她写批注。

examples.en: I pasted the outline into a Word document to organize it.
examples.zh: 我把提纲粘进「Word 文档」里整理。

words.enDefinition: a grid file like Excel used for data or planning

examples.en: We track all the project tasks in a shared spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 我们在「电子表格」里共同跟踪所有项目任务。

examples.en: Put your lab measurements into a spreadsheet before graphing them.
examples.zh: 画图之前，先把实验数据整理进「电子表格」。

words.enDefinition: a printed physical copy of your work

examples.en: The professor wants a hard copy in addition to the online upload.
examples.zh: 除了线上提交，教授还要一份「纸质版」。

examples.en: Print a hard copy the night before; the library printer always jams.
examples.zh: 前一晚就打印「纸质版」，图书馆打印机老卡纸。

collocations: a hard copy of your essay

words.enDefinition: the first page with your name, course, and title

examples.en: The cover page should list your name, course, and essay title.
examples.zh: 「封面页」要写上姓名、课程和作文题目。

examples.en: Forget the cover page and you lose two points automatically.
examples.zh: 忘写「封面页」会自动扣两分。

words.enDefinition: format text with a full blank line between lines

examples.en: Double-space the essay so the professor has room to comment.
examples.zh: 作文要「两倍行距」，方便教授写评语。

examples.en: Remember to double-space the whole document before you export the file.
examples.zh: 导出文件之前，记得把整份文档设置成「两倍行距」。

words.enDefinition: the rules for fonts, spacing, and layout

examples.en: Skim the formatting requirements before you start typing your essay.
examples.zh: 动笔写作文之前，先扫一眼「格式要求」。

examples.en: Half the point deductions came from ignoring the formatting requirements.
examples.zh: 一半的扣分都来自忽视「格式要求」。

words.enDefinition: a scan comparing your text against published sources

examples.en: Every essay goes through a plagiarism check before it is graded.
examples.zh: 每篇作文打分前都要过「查重」。

examples.en: Run a plagiarism check on your draft before you submit it.
examples.zh: 提交之前，先给初稿做一次「查重」。

words.enDefinition: the honesty rules against cheating and copying

examples.en: Sharing your code for the assignment breaks the academic integrity policy.
examples.zh: 把作业代码分享给别人违反「学术诚信」规定。

examples.en: The orientation covered academic integrity and how to collaborate properly.
examples.zh: 入学教育讲了「学术诚信」以及如何正当合作。

words.enDefinition: the saved record of earlier versions in shared docs

examples.en: The revision history proves exactly who wrote which section of the report.
examples.zh: 「修订历史」能证明报告的每个部分到底是谁写的。

examples.en: Use the revision history to recover the paragraph you deleted.
examples.zh: 用「修订历史」找回你删掉的段落。

words.enDefinition: the calendar day an assignment must be submitted by

examples.en: The due date for the essay moved from Friday to Monday.
examples.zh: 作文的「截止日期」从周五推迟到了周一。

examples.en: Write every due date into your planner during the first week.
examples.zh: 第一周就把每个「截止日期」写进计划本。

words.enDefinition: must be handed in the very next day

examples.en: The essay is due tomorrow and I still need a conclusion.
examples.zh: 作文「明天截止」，我还差个结论。

examples.en: My lab report is due tomorrow, so tonight is crunch time.
examples.zh: 实验报告「明天截止」，今晚进入冲刺模式。

words.enDefinition: finish and submit before the deadline passes

examples.en: We worked all weekend to meet the deadline for the report.
examples.zh: 为了赶上报告的「截止时间」，我们干了一整个周末。

examples.en: She trimmed two sections to meet the deadline in time.
examples.zh: 为了「赶上截止时间」，她删掉了两个部分。

words.enDefinition: fail to submit before the deadline passes

examples.en: Miss a deadline in this class and you lose ten percent.
examples.zh: 这门课「错过截止时间」就扣百分之十。

examples.en: I missed a deadline once and now I start assignments three days early.
examples.zh: 我「错过」过一次截止时间，现在都提前三天动笔。

collocations: miss a deadline by an hour

words.enDefinition: extra time officially added to a deadline

examples.en: The storm got everyone a deadline extension until Thursday afternoon.
examples.zh: 暴风雨让全班获得「延期」，改到周四下午交。

examples.en: He got a deadline extension because the portal crashed Sunday night.
examples.zh: 因为周日晚上门户崩溃，他拿到了「延期」。

words.enDefinition: a formal ask for more time on an assignment

examples.en: My extension request was approved within an hour of sending it.
examples.zh: 我的「延期申请」发出去一小时内就批了。

examples.en: Attach evidence when you send an extension request by email.
examples.zh: 发「延期申请」邮件时要附上证明材料。

words.enDefinition: formally request more time for an assignment

examples.en: It's better to ask for an extension than to submit unfinished work.
examples.zh: 与其交没写完的作业，不如「申请延期」。

examples.en: Email early if you plan to ask for an extension.
examples.zh: 想「申请延期」的话，要尽早发邮件。

collocations: ask the professor for an extension
never hurts to ask for an extension

words.enDefinition: progressing at the planned pace with nothing late

examples.en: We're on schedule: the outline is done, draft due next week.
examples.zh: 我们「按计划推进」：提纲已完成，初稿下周交。

examples.en: The extra Sunday meeting kept the whole project on schedule.
examples.zh: 临时加开的周日会议让整个项目「按计划推进」。

words.enDefinition: a short window after the deadline with no penalty

examples.en: The portal has a generous ten-minute grace period after midnight.
examples.zh: 门户在午夜后有十分钟宽裕的「宽限期」。

examples.en: Use the grace period only for genuine emergencies, never laziness.
examples.zh: 「宽限期」只留给真正的紧急情况，别拿懒散当借口。

words.enDefinition: a sudden serious problem at home that disrupts study

examples.en: A family emergency pulled her home the week the paper was due.
examples.zh: 论文截止那一周，她因「家庭急事」回了家。

examples.en: Tell your professor early if a family emergency affects your submission.
examples.zh: 如果「家庭急事」影响交作业，要尽早告诉教授。

words.zhGloss: 同时应对多个截止日期
words.enDefinition: handle several deadlines competing for the same days
acceptedZhAnswers: 同时应对多个截止日期

examples.en: I'm juggling deadlines from five different courses all this month.
examples.zh: 这个月我要「同时应对」五门课的截止日期。

examples.en: A planner makes it easier to juggle deadlines without panic.
examples.zh: 有了计划本，「同时应对多个截止日期」就不会慌。

words.enDefinition: the total amount of work you have to do

examples.en: My workload doubled when all three professors assigned essays at once.
examples.zh: 三位教授同时布置论文，我的「课业负担」翻倍了。

examples.en: A lighter workload this term lets me join a club.
examples.zh: 这学期「课业负担」轻一些，我可以参加社团了。

words.enDefinition: a period when many assignments land at once

examples.en: The workload crunch hit when four essays landed in one week.
examples.zh: 四篇作文挤在同一周，「任务高峰期」来了。

examples.en: During the workload crunch, even sleeping felt like a luxury.
examples.zh: 「任务高峰期」里，连睡觉都成了奢侈。

words.enDefinition: extremely busy with too much to do

examples.en: I'm swamped with three major assignments due the same day.
examples.zh: 三门大作业同一天交，我「忙得不可开交」。

examples.en: She was too swamped to help with the group project this week.
examples.zh: 她这周「忙得不可开交」，顾不上小组项目。

words.enDefinition: overloaded with so much work you can barely cope

examples.en: I'm totally snowed under with three problem sets this week.
examples.zh: 这周我被三份习题集「压得喘不过气」。

examples.en: He's been snowed under ever since the group project started.
examples.zh: 自从小组项目开始，他就一直「忙得团团转」。

words.enDefinition: the intense final period right before deadlines

examples.en: It's crunch time; the essay and the lab report are both due Friday.
examples.zh: 到「冲刺关头」了，作文和实验报告周五都要交。

examples.en: Everyone camps out in the library when crunch time starts.
examples.zh: 一到「冲刺关头」，大家都泡在图书馆。

words.enDefinition: feeling stressed because much is expected quickly

examples.en: I work best under pressure, but not with three essays at once.
examples.zh: 我「承受压力」时效率反而更高，但三篇作文一起也扛不住。

examples.en: She stays calm under pressure and usually finishes her work early.
examples.zh: 她「承受压力」时依然冷静，总能提前完成。

words.enDefinition: delay starting work you should be doing

examples.en: I procrastinated for a week and wrote the essay in one night.
examples.zh: 我「拖」了一周，最后一夜赶完作文。

examples.en: Stop procrastinating; even the outline alone will take two hours.
examples.zh: 别再「拖延」了，光提纲就要写两小时。

words.enDefinition: become so absorbed you forget how long you worked

examples.en: I lost track of time while rewriting and skipped dinner.
examples.zh: 我改稿改得「忘了时间」，晚饭都没吃。

examples.en: Set an alarm so you don't lose track of time on question one.
examples.zh: 定个闹钟，免得做第一题就「忘了时间」。

collocations: tend to lose track of time

words.enDefinition: keep working hard despite tiredness until finished

examples.en: I powered through the last forty pages of the reading.
examples.zh: 我「硬啃」完了阅读材料的最后四十页。

examples.en: Power through tonight; tomorrow you will only need to polish.
examples.zh: 今晚「咬牙冲完」，明天只需润色。

words.enDefinition: start working seriously after slacking off

examples.en: Time to buckle down; the draft is due this Monday.
examples.zh: 该「收心苦干」了，初稿这周一要交。

examples.en: Once the group finally picked a topic, everyone buckled down.
examples.zh: 小组终于定题之后，大家都「埋头苦干」起来。

words.enDefinition: a week packed with assignments and obligations

examples.en: With two essays and a quiz, this is a busy week.
examples.zh: 两篇作文加一个小测，真是「忙碌的一周」。

examples.en: Sunday planning keeps a busy week from spiraling out of control.
examples.zh: 周日做好规划，「忙碌的一周」才不会失控。

words.enDefinition: planning how to divide your hours across tasks

examples.en: Good time management means finishing everything before the panic starts.
examples.zh: 「时间管理」做得好，就能在慌乱来临前全部搞定。

examples.en: The first-year seminar teaches basic time management skills in week one.
examples.zh: 大一研讨课第一周就会教基本的「时间管理」技巧。

words.enDefinition: decide tasks early instead of reacting late

examples.en: Plan ahead and the big assignments stop feeling so scary.
examples.zh: 学会「提前规划」，大作业就没那么吓人了。

examples.en: Planning ahead kept the group project from collapsing in week ten.
examples.zh: 因为「提前规划」，小组项目没有在第十周崩盘。

words.enDefinition: decide which tasks matter most and do them first

examples.en: Prioritize the assignment that counts for thirty percent of the grade.
examples.zh: 「分清轻重缓急」，先做占三成成绩的那份作业。

examples.en: I prioritize my homework by due date and how much it's worth.
examples.zh: 我按截止日期和分值给作业「排优先级」。

words.enDefinition: a notebook or app where you schedule assignments

examples.en: Every Sunday I copy next week's deadlines into my planner.
examples.zh: 每周日我都把下周的截止日期抄进「计划本」。

examples.en: My planner shows the essay due the same day as the lab report.
examples.zh: 「计划本」显示作文和实验报告同一天截止。

words.enDefinition: reserve set hours on your schedule for one task

examples.en: Block out time tonight for the problem set, two full hours.
examples.zh: 今晚「留出整块时间」做习题集，整整两小时。

examples.en: I block out time each morning for the reading assignment.
examples.zh: 我每天早上都会「留出整块时间」做阅读任务。

words.enDefinition: reserve part of your day for a task

examples.en: Set aside time Sunday night to plan the whole week.
examples.zh: 周日晚「抽出时间」规划一周。

examples.en: Set aside time for revisions after you get peer feedback.
examples.zh: 拿到同伴反馈后，要「抽出时间」修改。

collocations: set aside an hour each day

words.enDefinition: keep control of tasks so nothing slips

examples.en: Check the syllabus weekly to stay on top of assignments.
examples.zh: 每周查课程大纲，才能「掌控住」作业进度。

examples.en: Staying on top of small tasks prevents deadline pileups later.
examples.zh: 小任务都「掌控住」，截止日期才不会堆成山。

collocations: hard to stay on top of everything

words.enDefinition: continuously know the state of something

examples.en: Keep track of which group member owes which section this week.
examples.zh: 这周要「随时掌握」每个组员负责哪一部分。

examples.en: I keep track of all my grades in a spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 我在电子表格里「跟进记录」各科成绩。

collocations: hard to keep track of everything

words.enDefinition: a list of items to verify before finishing

examples.en: Run through the whole submission checklist before you hit upload.
examples.zh: 点上传之前，把整份「核对清单」过一遍。

examples.en: My checklist includes format, word count, and the file name.
examples.zh: 我的「核对清单」包括格式、字数和文件名。

words.enDefinition: give yourself a treat after finishing work

examples.en: Reward yourself with milk tea after the essay is submitted.
examples.zh: 作文交完，用奶茶「奖励自己」。

examples.en: I reward myself with one episode per finished problem set.
examples.zh: 每做完一份习题集，我就「奖励自己」看一集剧。

collocations: a small way to reward yourself

words.enDefinition: one of the students working on a team project

examples.en: One group member never answered any messages all week long.
examples.zh: 有个「组员」一整周都不回任何消息。

examples.en: Every group member writes their name next to their task.
examples.zh: 每个「组员」都在自己的任务旁边写上名字。

words.enDefinition: a fellow member of your project team

examples.en: My teammate covered the slides while I handled the data.
examples.zh: 「队友」负责幻灯片，我处理数据。

examples.en: A good teammate flags problems early instead of hiding them.
examples.zh: 好的「队友」会及早提出问题，而不是藏着掖着。

words.enDefinition: someone who cooperates well in a group

examples.en: Professors can tell who's a team player during group work.
examples.zh: 小组作业时，教授看得出来谁「有团队精神」。

examples.en: Be a team player: share notes and cover for absent members.
examples.zh: 要做「有团队精神的人」：分享笔记，替缺席的成员补位。

words.enDefinition: the member who organizes the team's work

examples.en: Our group leader set a Sunday deadline for individual drafts.
examples.zh: 「小组组长」把个人初稿的截止时间定在周日。

examples.en: The group leader emails the professor on behalf of the team.
examples.zh: 「组长」代表全组给教授发邮件。

words.enDefinition: start organizing and guide the others

examples.en: Nobody wanted to start, so I took the lead on planning.
examples.zh: 没人想开头，我「牵头」做规划。

examples.en: She took the lead on contacting the professor about the deadline.
examples.zh: 就截止日期的事，她「牵头」去联系教授。

collocations: take the lead on a project

words.enDefinition: decide who does which job in the group

examples.en: Assign roles early in the project so nobody stands around confused.
examples.zh: 项目一开始就「分配角色」，免得有人干站着。

examples.en: Our professor made us assign roles in the very first meeting.
examples.zh: 教授要求第一次开会就「分配角色」。

words.enDefinition: splitting the work into separate parts for members

examples.en: A clear division of labor kept our project on schedule.
examples.zh: 明确的「分工」让项目按期推进。

examples.en: Our division of labor fell apart when one member vanished.
examples.zh: 一位成员失联后，我们的「分工」全乱了。

collocations: agree on the division of labor

words.enDefinition: hand specific jobs out to team members

examples.en: Leaders who delegate tasks early avoid the final-week deadline crunch.
examples.zh: 尽早「分派任务」的组长能避开最后一周的赶工。

examples.en: The leader delegated tasks based on each member's individual strengths.
examples.zh: 组长按每个人的长处「分派任务」。

words.enDefinition: do most of the work while others contribute little

examples.en: She carried the whole team when two members went quiet.
examples.zh: 两位成员失联后，是她「扛起了全组」。

examples.en: I'm so tired of carrying the team through every deadline.
examples.zh: 每次都是我「扛起全组」赶截止日期，我太累了。

collocations: carry the team on group projects

words.enDefinition: handle the hardest, biggest part of the work

examples.en: Maya did the heavy lifting on the data analysis section.
examples.zh: 数据分析部分由 Maya「挑大梁」。

examples.en: You did the heavy lifting; let me handle the slides.
examples.zh: 你已经「挑了大梁」，幻灯片交给我。

collocations: do the heavy lifting on the report

words.enDefinition: work less hard than you should

examples.en: He slacked off for weeks and panicked the night before.
examples.zh: 他「偷懒」了几周，交稿前夜才慌。

examples.en: Don't slack off just because the deadline is far away.
examples.zh: 别因为截止日期还远就「摸鱼」。

collocations: slack off early in the term

words.enDefinition: a scheduled get-together to work on the project

examples.en: Our group meeting is Sundays at the library, third floor.
examples.zh: 我们的「小组会议」定在周日，图书馆三楼。

examples.en: Skip two group meetings and the team starts without you.
examples.zh: 缺席两次「小组会议」，大家就会甩开你推进。

words.enDefinition: two commitments that clash on the calendar

examples.en: A scheduling conflict with practice means we meet Thursday instead.
examples.zh: 因为训练的「时间冲突」，我们改到周四见面。

examples.en: Half the team has a scheduling conflict with evening meetings.
examples.zh: 一半成员晚上有「时间冲突」，没法开会。

collocations: sorry, I have a scheduling conflict

words.enDefinition: briefly meet or message to share progress

examples.en: Let's check in every Wednesday so that nobody falls behind.
examples.zh: 我们每周三「碰一次进度」，免得有人掉队。

examples.en: The professor asks groups to check in by email weekly.
examples.zh: 教授要求各小组每周邮件「同步进度」。

words.enDefinition: an online file everyone in the team can edit

examples.en: Put the outline in a shared document so everyone can comment.
examples.zh: 把提纲放进「共享文档」，大家都能评论。

examples.en: Our shared document clearly shows who edited which paragraph last.
examples.zh: 「共享文档」能清楚看出谁最后改了哪一段。

collocations: a shared document for the outline

words.enDefinition: a common drive folder holding the team's files

examples.en: Drop all your sources into the shared folder before Friday.
examples.zh: 周五前把所有资料放进「共享文件夹」。

examples.en: The shared folder holds our drafts, data sets, and slides.
examples.zh: 「共享文件夹」里放着我们的草稿、数据和幻灯片。

collocations: upload it to the shared folder

words.enDefinition: permission to make changes to a shared file

examples.en: Give every group member edit access before the first draft.
examples.zh: 初稿之前要给每个组员开「编辑权限」。

examples.en: I only had view rights, so I requested edit access.
examples.zh: 我只有查看权，所以申请了「编辑权限」。

words.enDefinition: members rating each other's contribution to a project

examples.en: Our peer evaluation scores adjust each person's final grade individually.
examples.zh: 「组内互评」的分数会单独调整每人的最终成绩。

examples.en: The peer evaluation form asks how fairly the work was divided.
examples.zh: 「互评表」会问分工是否公平。

words.enDefinition: one score the whole team receives for a project

examples.en: Everyone gets exactly the same group grade on this project.
examples.zh: 这个项目所有人拿完全相同的「小组共同成绩」。

examples.en: Your individual reflection can slightly adjust the group grade at the end.
examples.zh: 个人反思在最后会微调「小组共同成绩」。

words.enDefinition: the member who delivers part of a talk

examples.en: Each presenter gets exactly two minutes, and not a second more.
examples.zh: 每位「汇报人」限时正好两分钟，一秒都不能超。

examples.en: Practice the handovers so one presenter doesn't talk over another.
examples.zh: 排练好交接，免得「汇报人」互相抢话。

words.enDefinition: practice a presentation before delivering it

examples.en: Rehearse the whole talk twice with a timer before presentation day.
examples.zh: 展示日之前拿计时器把整场「排练」两遍。

examples.en: We rehearsed the handovers between speakers until they were smooth.
examples.zh: 我们反复「排练」演讲者之间的交接，直到流畅为止。

words.enDefinition: a checkpoint marking major progress on a project

examples.en: Finish the user survey by Friday; it's our first milestone.
examples.zh: 周五前完成用户问卷，这是我们的第一个「阶段节点」。

examples.en: The professor checks progress at each milestone of the project.
examples.zh: 教授会在项目的每个「阶段节点」来查进度。

words.enDefinition: the member who keeps everyone's parts moving together

examples.en: As coordinator, I track deadlines and progress for every section.
examples.zh: 作为「统筹人」，我跟踪各部分的截止日期和进度。

examples.en: Our coordinator merged everyone's slides into one single deck overnight.
examples.zh: 「统筹人」连夜把大家的幻灯片合成了一份。

words.enDefinition: work achieved by everyone contributing together

examples.en: Getting the report in on time took a real group effort.
examples.zh: 报告能按时交，靠的是大家的「共同努力」。

examples.en: The presentation was a group effort from outline to delivery.
examples.zh: 这次展示从提纲到上台都是「集体努力」的成果。

collocations: the result of a group effort

words.enDefinition: the written record of what a meeting decided

examples.en: Post the meeting notes in the shared folder tonight, please.
examples.zh: 麻烦今晚把「会议记录」传到共享文件夹。

examples.en: Our meeting notes list every task and the person responsible.
examples.zh: 「会议记录」上列了每项任务和负责人。

words.enDefinition: the specific tasks agreed at a meeting

examples.en: Every meeting should end with clear action items and owners.
examples.zh: 每次开会都应该定下明确的「待办事项」和负责人。

examples.en: I emailed the action items to everyone after Sunday's meeting.
examples.zh: 周日开完会，我把「待办事项」邮件发给了大家。

collocations: follow up on the action items

words.enDefinition: all the assignments a course requires

examples.en: This course's coursework includes labs, essays, and a final report.
examples.zh: 这门课的「课程作业」包括实验、作文和期末报告。

examples.en: Coursework stacks up fast if you skip a single week.
examples.zh: 只要落下一周，「课程作业」就会堆成山。

words.enDefinition: work you created yourself, not copied

examples.en: The submission page makes you promise the file is original work.
examples.zh: 提交页面要求你承诺文件是「原创作品」。

examples.en: Recycled essays from other classes don't count as original work.
examples.zh: 从别的课回收来的论文不算「原创作品」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum time allowed for a task or talk

examples.en: The presentation has a strict ten-minute time limit this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期的展示有严格的十分钟「时间限制」。

examples.en: Practice under the time limit or you will run long.
examples.zh: 要在「时间限制」内练习，不然会超时。

collocations: the time limit is ten minutes

words.enDefinition: do problems or steps one by one until done

examples.en: Work through the problem set in order; each builds on the last.
examples.zh: 习题集要按顺序「逐题做完」，题目环环相扣。

examples.en: We worked through the sample questions together before starting ours.
examples.zh: 动笔之前，我们一起把例题「过了一遍」。

words.enDefinition: be unable to continue on a problem

examples.en: I got stuck on question six for almost an hour.
examples.zh: 第六题我「卡」了快一个小时。

examples.en: If you get stuck, post the question on the class forum.
examples.zh: 「卡住」了就把问题发到课程论坛。

words.enDefinition: request assistance when you cannot manage alone

examples.en: Ask for help early instead of struggling in silence for weeks.
examples.zh: 别闷头硬撑几周，早点「求助」。

examples.en: The TA encourages students to ask for help during lab hours.
examples.zh: 助教鼓励大家在实验课时间「提问求助」。

collocations: not afraid to ask for help

words.enDefinition: the last completed version of a file or paper

examples.en: Email me the final version tonight so I can review it.
examples.zh: 今晚把「最终版」发我，我好看一遍。

examples.en: Compare the final version with the rough draft to see your progress.
examples.zh: 把「最终版」和初稿对比，能看到你的进步。

collocations: the final version of the report

words.enDefinition: an explanation that removes confusion about a task

examples.en: I emailed the TA to ask for clarification on part two.
examples.zh: 第二部分我不懂，邮件向助教要了「澄清说明」。

examples.en: The professor posted a quick clarification about the word count.
examples.zh: 教授就字数问题补发了一份「澄清说明」。

words.enDefinition: unfinished work piling up from earlier days

examples.en: The long weekend cleared my backlog of problem sets completely.
examples.zh: 长周末我清完了「积压任务」，全是习题集。

examples.en: One lazy week creates a backlog that takes three to fix.
examples.zh: 松懈一周，「积压任务」要花三周才能还清。
